items.title: What investors 'really' need to see from Oracle earnings this week
items.summary: Oracle (ORCL) is reporting quarterly earnings results on Thursday. Bloomberg Intelligence senior technology credit analyst Robert Schiffman shares what investors should be keeping an eye on in the earnings print, especially from a debt-issuance perspective.

items.title: Qualcomm Stock Pops as Amazon Deal Ramps Up AI Ambitions
items.summary: The chip maker and online retailer are teaming up to build data-center infrastructure, including chips and optical networking products.

items.title: Alphabet Stock Is Pulling Back From Its High. Here’s Why I’d Buy the Dip.
items.summary: Alphabet just posted blowout earnings and yet the stock has shed more than 10% from its peak, leaving investors caught between soaring Cloud growth and a balance sheet that suddenly looks very different from a year ago.

items.title: One Stock Is Weighing Heavily on the Dow

items.title: SanDisk Up Over 40% Past Month: Can the Rally Last?
items.summary: SanDisk has surged more than 40% in a month on AI-driven memory demand. Can strong fundamentals and an upbeat outlook keep the rally going?

items.summary: CRM's 34% monthly rally is backed by stabilizing growth, surging Agentforce ARR and a valuation below major enterprise software rivals.

items.title: Advanced Micro Devices and Marvell Technology Keep Growing Their Revenue. Here's What Else to Watch.

items.title: Why Oracle’s Low-Cost Cloud Changes Everything
items.summary: Oracle's stock has dropped nearly 28% over the past year, yet one investor keeps hitting the buy button on every leg lower. The reason sits inside a structural bet on cloud infrastructure that most Wall Street reflexes completely overlook.
